title: Robotic Surgery in the Treatment of Deep Endometriosis: Da Vinci Vs HUGO RAS Comparison
official: Robotic Surgery in the Treatment of Deep Endometriosis: Da Vinci Vs HUGO RAS Compared
summary: The aim is to clarify whether both surgical approaches represent, equivalently, a good treatment for the management of patients with deep endometriosis who are candidates for surgery, or whether there are any differences between the two methods, and, if so, how they differ

sites.f: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli IRCCS, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore
